protocol.common: Same eligible corpus, Mongolian lexical aliases, E5 prefixes/pooling, max two passages/page, overlap/news exclusion.
protocol.bm25: Positive lexical scores only; Mongolian normalized query/document terms.
protocol.e5: Dense scores; no lexical/topic abstention; local pinned model required.
protocol.rrf: Lexical positive ranks + dense ranks; no extra boosts or lexical/topic gates.
protocol.rrf_boosted: RRF + anchor/category boosts; no lexical/topic gates.
protocol.production: Existing RRF+boosts+lexical/topic gates. Default chat retrieval unchanged.
protocol.latency: Diagnostic timings only; same model cache shared, order rotated by query. Not a controlled speed benchmark.
